<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <RelativeLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="#FFFFFFFF" tools:context="no.ntnuf.gliderlog.newflight.NewFlightActivity">
<androidx.appcompat.widget.Toolbar android:id="@+id/toolbarnewtow" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="?attr/actionBarSize" android:background="?attr/colorPrimary" android:elevation="4dp" android:theme="@style/ThemeOverlay.AppCompat.Dark" app:popupTheme="@style/ThemeOverlay.AppCompat.Light" />
<ScrollView android:id="@+id/newFlightScroll" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:layout_below="@+id/toolbarnewtow" android:fillViewport="true">
<RelativeLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:layout_alignParentBottom="true" android:layout_alignParentLeft="true" android:paddingLeft="16dp" android:paddingTop="16dp" android:paddingRight="16dp" android:paddingBottom="16dp">
<TextView android:id="@+id/gliderRegistrationTitle" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="true" android:layout_alignParentTop="true" android:layout_marginTop="10dp" android:text="Glider Registration" android:textAppearance="?android:attr/textAppearanceMedium" />
<AutoCompleteTextView android:id="@+id/gliderRegistrationIn" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="true" android:layout_below="@+id/gliderRegistrationTitle" android:capitalize="characters" android:ems="10" android:imeOptions="actionNext" android:inputType="textCapCharacters" android:nextFocusDown="@+id/pilotNameTitle" android:text="LN-G" android:textSize="30sp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/pilotNameTitle" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="true" android:layout_below="@+id/gliderRegistrationIn" android:text="Pilot Name" android:textAppearance="?android:attr/textAppearanceMedium" />
<RadioGroup android:id="@+id/pilotTypeIn" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_below="@+id/pilotNameTitle" android:orientation="horizontal">
<RadioButton android:id="@+id/radio_pic" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:checked="true" android:text="Pilot In Command" />
<RadioButton android:id="@+id/radio_instructor" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Instructor" /> </RadioGroup>
<AutoCompleteTextView android:id="@+id/pilotNameIn" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="true" android:layout_below="@+id/pilotTypeIn" android:capitalize="words" android:ems="10" android:imeOptions="actionNext" android:inputType="textCapWords|textPersonName" android:nextFocusDown="@+id/coPilotNameIn" android:textSize="30sp" />
<ImageView android:id="@+id/pilotNameCheckmark" android:layout_width="30dp" android:layout_height="30dp" android:layout_alignBottom="@+id/pilotNameIn" android:layout_alignParentEnd="true" android:layout_marginBottom="15dp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/coPilotNameTitle" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="true" android:layout_below="@+id/pilotNameCheckmark" android:text="Co-pilot name (optional)" android:textAppearance="?android:attr/textAppearanceMedium" />
<RadioGroup android:id="@+id/copilotTypeIn" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_below="@+id/coPilotNameTitle" android:orientation="horizontal">
<RadioButton android:id="@+id/radio_student" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:checked="true" android:text="Student" />
<RadioButton android:id="@+id/radio_passenger" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="Passenger" /> </RadioGroup>
<AutoCompleteTextView android:id="@+id/coPilotNameIn" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="true" android:layout_below="@+id/copilotTypeIn" android:capitalize="words" android:ems="10" android:imeOptions="actionNext" android:inputType="textCapWords|textPersonName" android:nextFocusDown="@+id/notesIn" android:text="" android:textSize="30sp" />
<ImageView android:id="@+id/copilotNameCheckmark" android:layout_width="30dp" android:layout_height="30dp" android:layout_alignBottom="@+id/coPilotNameIn" android:layout_alignParentEnd="true" android:layout_marginBottom="15dp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/notesTitle" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="true" android:layout_below="@+id/coPilotNameIn" android:text="Additional notes (optional)" android:textAppearance="?android:attr/textAppearanceMedium" />
<AutoCompleteTextView android:id="@+id/notesIn" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="true" android:layout_below="@+id/notesTitle" android:capitalize="sentences" android:ems="10" android:imeOptions="actionDone" android:inputType="textCapSentences" android:text="" android:textSize="30sp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/timestampsTitle" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="true" android:layout_below="@+id/notesIn" android:text="Takeoff | Release | Landing" android:textAppearance="?android:attr/textAppearanceMedium" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/takeoffTimeIn" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="false" android:layout_below="@+id/timestampsTitle" android:paddingRight="30dp" android:text="00:00" android:textAppearance="?android:attr/textAppearanceLarge" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/releaseTimeIn" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="false" android:layout_below="@+id/timestampsTitle" android:layout_toRightOf="@+id/takeoffTimeIn" android:paddingRight="30dp" android:text="03:00" android:textAppearance="?android:attr/textAppearanceLarge" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/landingTimeIn" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentStart="false" android:layout_below="@+id/timestampsTitle" android:layout_toRightOf="@+id/releaseTimeIn" android:text="06:00" android:textAppearance="?android:attr/textAppearanceLarge" />
<com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.FloatingActionButton android:id="@+id/startTowButton" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_alignParentBottom="true" android:layout_alignParentRight="true" android:layout_margin="16dp" android:src="@android:drawable/ic_input_add" android:tint="@color/white" />
</RelativeLayout> </ScrollView>
</RelativeLayout>
